title: The Glory of God
definition: The glory of God is the display of His infinite worth, beauty, holiness, greatness, power, and majesty.
summary: God's glory is seen in creation, revealed in Scripture, displayed in His works, and most clearly shown in Jesus Christ. Everything exists from Him, through Him, and for Him.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the supreme revelation of God's glory. In Him, the glory of God is seen not only in power and majesty, but also in grace, truth, humility, suffering, resurrection, and redemption.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God's glory is His greatness made known. Creation declares it, Scripture reveals it, worship responds to it, and Christ displays it most fully.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: If God is glorious, then life is not ultimately about human fame, comfort, or control. We were created to know, worship, and glorify Him.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek God's glory above your own. Let your words, choices, suffering, service, worship, and witness point people to the greatness of God in Christ.
